description: This source file implements the ClientHandler class and related functionalities for managing WebRTC client connections, including track management, signaling, and connection state handling within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: ClientVideoTrackImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ClientVideoTrackInterface that manages adding, updating, and removing video sinks and tracks for WebRTC video streams.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateSink
methods.description: Adds or updates a sink for the video track, allowing the client to receive video frames.

methods.name: SetVideoTrack
methods.description: Sets the video track for the client, updating sinks accordingly.

methods.name: UnsetVideoTrack
methods.description: Unsets the current video track if it matches the provided track.

methods.name: ClientHandler::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClientHandler instance.

methods.name: ClientHandler::ClientHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientHandler with necessary parameters.

methods.name: AddTrackToConnection
methods.description: Adds a media track to the peer connection and returns the sender interface.

methods.name: AddDisplay
methods.description: Adds a video display track to the peer connection.

methods.name: RemoveDisplay
methods.description: Removes a display track from the peer connection.

methods.name: AddAudio
methods.description: Adds an audio track to the peer connection.

methods.name: GetCameraStream
methods.description: Returns the camera video stream interface.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a signaling message to the client.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and initializes the peer connection, re-adding tracks and setting configurations.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the client connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: OnConnectionStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the connection state, triggering appropriate actions.

methods.name: OnDataChannel
methods.description: Handles the event of a new data channel opening.

methods.name: OnTrack
methods.description: Handles the event of a new media track being received.

methods.name: OnRemoveTrack
methods.description: Handles the removal of a media track.
